density_profile.focus_rule: Paths, silhouettes, and combat telegraphs keep the strongest value contrast even as detail increases.
density_profile.folklore_rule: Every metatile carries at least one cathedral-grotesque or daemon-corrupted architectural cue.

depth_notes: thin foam fringe at the horizon edge
gothic_motifs: raft ribs echo a collapsed chapel roof
foam mouths curl like worn gargoyle spillways
a snapped mast reads like a broken processional standard
micro_forms: rope knots grouped like bead relics
shell crescents tucked into sand pockets
plank nails breaking the timber edge
small claw-like foam hooks under the wreck
pixel_exchange_notes: Every added plank chip should be balanced by shaving an adjacent foam fringe.
Rope beads stay on the outer contour while the interior boards are trimmed thinner.

depth_notes: foreground path must be the highest contrast
dunes curve to frame player travel
gothic_motifs: dune shoulders rise like buried buttresses
thorn grass reads like low tracery along the path
micro_forms: split hoof prints mixed into the sand
reed shadows stitched across the path edge
tiny stone chips marking travel rhythm
swept ripples that converge toward the safe route
pixel_exchange_notes: Each new wind line removes equal mass from a nearby dune band.
Grass silhouettes stay sharp by hollowing the sand behind them rather than thickening the tuft.

depth_notes: keep near grass darker than the horizon
mid band should imply rolling land
flower strip is decorative, not noisy
gothic_motifs: distant fence posts read like a shattered cloister rhythm
horizon breaks hint at ruined shrine arches
flower clusters form rosary-like repetition rather than random scatter
micro_forms: paired blade clumps at the foreground edge
small bloom knots locked to the path of travel
low shadow cups under each roll of land
distant ruin marks kept sparse and vertical
pixel_exchange_notes: New bloom pixels must come from cut grass voids, not wider meadows.
Horizon ruins stay thin by carving sky gaps between their ribs.

depth_notes: banner points toward the intended approach
packed soil should read flatter than meadow grass
gothic_motifs: stakes align like a bare nave frame
brace planks echo pointed arch geometry
banner tears suggest a pilgrim standard reclaimed from ruin
micro_forms: rope lashings at stake joins
tool marks cut into the topsoil
nail heads and wedge chips along the plank stack
banner fringe and seam breaks
pixel_exchange_notes: When banner tears are added, remove cloth bulk from the hem silhouette.
Soil cuts should sharpen the post bases without enlarging the foundation mass.

depth_notes: glyph face gets the brightest value step
offering ring should pull the eye to center
gothic_motifs: monolith crown borrows the read of a pointed canopy
glyph recesses behave like broken tracery windows
the offering ring frames the base like a saint niche gone uncanny
micro_forms: chip lines around each glyph recess
hairline cracks descending from the crown
tiny votive stones circling the plinth
shadow crescents under offerings
pixel_exchange_notes: Added glyph hooks must be balanced by cutting extra air into the inner recesses.
The crown silhouette stays narrow by trimming side chips when top ornament is added.

depth_notes: void break is darkest and cleanest
spine rocks angle inward toward the arena
impact cracks carry motion into telegraph spaces
gothic_motifs: spine rocks rise like failed flying buttresses
void breaches resemble open gargoyle maws
broken shrine ribs create an arena of corrupted architecture
micro_forms: tooth-like chips along the void lip
ash eddies caught between spine stones
small relic fragments embedded in the grit
crack branches that aim toward attack lanes
pixel_exchange_notes: Every added tooth on the void lip removes equal dark mass from the adjacent rock shelf.
Crack branches stay thin by opening ash gaps instead of thickening the line.
